'''Josep A. Planell i Estany''' (born 1951) is a Spanish academic.

Planell was born in [[Barcelona]], graduated in [[Physics]] from the [[University of Barcelona]] in 1975 and earned his doctorate in Materials Science from Queen Mary, [[University of London]], in 1983. Since 1992 he has been full professor in the Materials Science and Metallurgy department of the Barcelona School of [[Industrial Engineering]] at the [[Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya]]. He served as President of the [[Universitat Oberta de Catalunya]] between 2013<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ara.cat/societat/Josep-Planell-UOC-internacionalitzacio-principals_0_894510681.html |title=Josep A. Planell pren possessió com a rector de la UOC amb la recerca i la internacionalització com a principals reptes |author=Diari Ara |date=3 April 2013 |language=Catalan }}</ref> and 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Àngels Fitó Bertran, new UOC president |url=https://biblioteca.uoc.edu/en/biblioguides/biblioguide/Angels-Fito-Bertran-new-UOC-president/ |access-date=2023-06-11 |website=biblioteca.uoc.edu |language=en}}</ref>

In 2013, he received the [[George D. Winter]] award from the [[European Society for Biomaterials]]. An international jury of experts selected Planell for this prestigious award. He was the first Spanish scientist to receive it and he did so “for his excellence in the research, vision and dissemination of the science of biomaterials, which is widely renowned in the scientific community”.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.uoc.edu/portal/en/sala-de-premsa/actualitat/noticies/2013/noticia_138/premi-josep-a-planell.html |title=Josep A. Planell receives the George Winter 2013 international award for research and promoting biomaterials science |author=UOC }}</ref>

Likewise, in 2001 he was awarded the Catalan government's Distinction for the Promotion of University Research and in 2006 he received the City of [[Barcelona]] award,<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bcn.cat/cultura/premisciutatbcn/2006/ |title=Reial Acadèmia de Doctors. Excm. Sr. Dr. Josep Anton Planell Estany |language=Catalan }}</ref> in the technological research category. He has been member of the Catalan Royal Academy of Doctors<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.reialacademiadoctors.cat/en/numerari/excm-sr-dr-josep-anton-planell-estany |title=Premis Ciutat de Barcelona, 2006. Investigació Tecnològica: Maria Pau Ginebra, Josep Anton Planell, Conrado Aparicio, Elisabeth Engel i Damien Lacroix
 |language=Catalan }}</ref> since 2006 and is an elected member of [[Barcelona's Royal Academy of Arts and Sciences]].
